summary: Tested new installation-creation-with-equipment-association flow (SmartLife gainable + thermostats), moderator write rights, role gating, and light auth regression. All 38 backend tests pass; UI wizard works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Test installations created during previous iterations (TEST_Installer_Install, TEST_Invite_Install, TEST_Installer_Config, TEST_Moderator_Config, TEST_Admin_Config, TEST_NoMaster_Config, TEST_UI_Wizard, etc.) linger in DB — no DELETE /api/installations endpoint exists. Consider adding one or auto-cleanup by prefix for developer hygiene.
seed_installation_equipment mutates the input zones_spec (sets first.master=True when none provided). Minor side-effect but harmless for now.
CreateInstallationDialog imports 'Cube' from @phosphor-icons/react but never uses it — dead import.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed installations during backend + UI runs (TEST_Installer_Config, TEST_Moderator_Config, TEST_Admin_Config, TEST_NoMaster_Config, TEST_UI_Wizard). Demo installation 'Maison Client Démo' + 5 demo users intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now covers TestInstallationCreateWithConfig (installer/moderator/admin create with gainable+thermostat spec, master defaulting, client/guest 403). Frontend wizard confirmed: fields installation-name-input, gainable-name-input, gainable-id-input, zone-name-{i}, zone-icon-{i}, zone-thermo-{i}, zone-master-{i}, zone-remove-{i}, add-zone-btn, auto-associate-btn, create-submit-btn all functional. After submit, navigates to /installations/{id} and both zone names (with custom master) and device product IDs render in Appareils tab.
verified_features: POST /api/installations accepts full config and seeds zones with is_master + devices with product_id
MODERATOR can create installations (200) and gets can_write=true on owned; still forbidden on others
SUPER_ADMIN + INSTALLER can create; CLIENT + GUEST get 403
Wizard: installer submits payload -> navigate to detail page -> custom zone names + master zone + thermostats + gainable with entered product IDs display
Home create-installation-btn visible for installer/moderator/admin, hidden for client/guest
Login regression: all 5 roles login OK; guest still read-only on demo install
